def transform(g):
    import collections
    H,W=len(g),len(g[0])
    cnt=collections.Counter(x for row in g for x in row)
    bg=cnt.most_common(1)[0][0]
    # marker color: color having a cell with same-color neighbors both vertical & horizontal (corner of an L)
    best=None
    for c in range(10):
        if c==bg: continue
        cells=[(r,cc) for r in range(H) for cc in range(W) if g[r][cc]==c]
        cs=set(cells)
        for (r,cc) in cells:
            if ((r+1,cc) in cs or (r-1,cc) in cs) and ((r,cc+1) in cs or (r,cc-1) in cs):
                best=(c,r,cc); break
        if best: break
    c,cr,cc=best
    # vertical arm direction from corner
    dr=0
    for d in (1,-1):
        if (cr+d,cc) in cs: dr=d
    step=-dr
    r=cr+step
    o=None
    while 0<=r<H:
        v=g[r][cc]
        if v!=bg and v!=c:
            o=(r,cc); break
        r+=step
    # flood object
    orr,occ=o; oc=g[orr][occ]
    st=[(orr,occ)]; obj={(orr,occ)}
    while st:
        r0,c0=st.pop()
        for q in ((r0+1,c0),(r0-1,c0),(r0,c0+1),(r0,c0-1)):
            if 0<=q[0]<H and 0<=q[1]<W and q not in obj and g[q[0]][q[1]]==oc:
                obj.add(q); st.append(q)
    out=[row[:] for row in g]
    for (r0,c0) in obj: out[r0][c0]=c
    return out

    objs=comps(g,bg)
    col,corner,mcells=find_marker(g,bg)
    (r0,c0)=corner
    vert=[(r,c) for r,c in mcells if c==c0]
    horz=[(r,c) for r,c in mcells if r==r0]
    out=[row[:] for row in g]

        line=c0; longer_side='left' if any(c<c0 for r,c in horz) else 'right'
        ok=(lambda r,c: c<line) if longer_side=='right' else (lambda r,c: c>line)
    else:
        line=r0; longer_side='down' if any(r>r0 for r,c in vert) else 'up'
        ok=(lambda r,c: r<line) if longer_side=='down' else (lambda r,c: r>line)

def transform2(g):
    bg=collections.Counter(x for row in g for x in row).most_common(1)[0][0]

    (r0,c0)=corner
    vert=[(r,c) for r,c in mcells if c==c0]; horz=[(r,c) for r,c in mcells if r==r0]

    if len(vert)<len(horz):  # shorter arm vertical -> region side, weight 2 on rows
        longer_side='left' if any(c<c0 for r,c in horz) else 'right'
        ok=(lambda r,c: c<c0) if longer_side=='right' else (lambda r,c: c>c0)
        dist=lambda r,c: 2*abs(r-r0)+abs(c-c0)

def transform3(g, verbose=False):
    bg=collections.Counter(x for row in g for x in row).most_common(1)[0][0]
    col,corner,mcells=find_marker(g,bg)
    (r0,c0)=corner
    vert=[(r,c) for r,c in mcells if c==c0]; horz=[(r,c) for r,c in mcells if r==r0]
    out=[row[:] for row in g]
    if len(vert)<len(horz):
        longer_side='left' if any(c<c0 for r,c in horz) else 'right'
        ok=(lambda r,c: c<c0) if longer_side=='right' else (lambda r,c: c>c0)
        dist=lambda r,c: 2*abs(r-r0)+abs(c-c0)
        longer=set(horz)
    else:
        longer_side='down' if any(r>r0 for r,c in vert) else 'up'
        ok=(lambda r,c: r<r0) if longer_side=='down' else (lambda r,c: r>r0)
        dist=lambda r,c: abs(r-r0)+2*abs(c-c0)
        longer=set(vert)
    def bad(cells):
        for r,c in cells:
            if abs(r-r0)+abs(c-c0)==1: return True          # touches corner
            if any(abs(r-mr)+abs(c-mc)==1 for mr,mc in longer): return True  # touches longer arm

    best=min(cand)
    if verbose: print('  best',best[0],best[2],best[1],'n',len(cand))
    for r,c in best[3]: out[r][c]=col

def feats(g,og):
    bg=collections.Counter(x for row in g for x in row).most_common(1)[0][0]
    col,corner,mcells=find_marker(g,bg)
    (r0,c0)=corner
    vert=sorted(r for r,c in mcells if c==c0); horz=sorted(c for r,c in mcells if r==r0)
    vn=vert[-1]-vert[0]+1; hn=horz[-1]-horz[0]+1
    changed={(r,c) for r in range(len(g)) for c in range(len(g[0])) if g[r][c]!=og[r][c]}
    rows=[]
    for o in comps(g,bg):
        oc,cells=o
        if cells==mcells: continue
        S=len(cells)
        dc=min(abs(r-r0)+abs(c-c0) for r,c in cells)
        dm=min(min(abs(r-mr)+abs(c-mc) for mr,mc in mcells) for r,c in cells)
        tc=any(abs(r-r0)+abs(c-c0)==1 for r,c in cells)
        tm=any(abs(r-mr)+abs(c-mc)==1 for r,c in cells for mr,mc in mcells)
        tv=any(abs(r-mr)+abs(c-mc)==1 for r,c in cells for mr,mc in mcells if mc==c0)
        th=any(abs(r-mr)+abs(c-mc)==1 for r,c in cells for mr,mc in mcells if mr==r0)
        rs=[r for r,c in cells]; cs=[c for r,c in cells]
        rows.append(dict(color=oc,size=S,dc=dc,dm=dm,tc=tc,tm=tm,tv=tv,th=th,
                         rmin=min(rs),rmax=max(rs),cmin=min(cs),cmax=max(cs),
                         w=len(set(cs)),h=len(set(rs)),
                         tgt=changed.issubset(set(cells)) and bool(changed & set(cells)),
                         cells=cells))
    return dict(bg=bg,col=col,corner=corner,vn=vn,hn=hn,objs=rows,changed=changed)
F={n:feats(g,og) for n,(g,og) in dict([('D1',(inp,outp)),('D2',(in2,out2)),('D3',(in3,out3)),('D4',demo4)]).items()}
for n,f in F.items():
    print(n,'marker',f['col'],f['corner'],'arms V',f['vn'],'H',f['hn'])
    for o in sorted(f['objs'],key=lambda o:o['dc'])[:8]:

# redo: need marker cells; recompute with direction info
def feats2(g,og):
    bg=collections.Counter(x for row in g for x in row).most_common(1)[0][0]
    col,corner,mcells=find_marker(g,bg)
    (r0,c0)=corner
    vcells=[r for r,c in mcells if c==c0 and r!=r0]; hcells=[c for r,c in mcells if r==r0 and c!=c0]
    vdir='down' if vcells and max(vcells)>r0 else 'up'
    hdir='right' if hcells and max(hcells)>c0 else 'left'
    vn=len(vcells)+1; hn=len(hcells)+1
    changed={(r,c) for r in range(len(g)) for c in range(len(g[0])) if g[r][c]!=og[r][c]}
    out=[]
    for o in comps(g,bg):
        oc,cells=o
        if cells==mcells: continue
        S=len(cells)
        # perpendicular distance to vert-arm line (col c0) = min |c-c0| over cells? use perp of nearest
        pv=min(abs(c-c0) for r,c in cells)
        ph=min(abs(r-r0) for r,c in cells)
        # signed direction along vert arm axis: projection sign
        sv=min((r-r0)*(1 if vdir=='down' else -1) for r,c in cells)  # negative = opposite side of vert arm
        sh=min((c-c0)*(1 if hdir=='right' else -1) for r,c in cells)
        dc=min(abs(r-r0)+abs(c-c0) for r,c in cells)
        tc=any(abs(r-r0)+abs(c-c0)==1 for r,c in cells)
        tv=any(abs(r-mr)+abs(c-mc)==1 for r,c in cells for mr,mc in mcells if mc==c0)
        th=any(abs(r-mr)+abs(c-mc)==1 for r,c in cells for mr,mc in mcells if mr==r0)
